    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Board
    Represents game board for Clue.
    Card
    Represents a Clue card.
    CardDeck
    Represents deck of cards made up of Card objects.
    CaseFile
    Represents the hidden case file for the Clue game.
    ClueLauncher
    Launches and tests the Clue game (text based).
    Dice
    Dice object created, allowing player to roll a random number 1-6.
    FXBoardPanel
    Creating the physical board (GUI)
    GameManager
    Manages overall clue game logic.
    Location
    Interface used to represent a location on the Clue game board.
    Player
    Represents a player in the Clue game.
    Room
    Represents a room on the Clue board.
    Tile
    Represents a single tile on the Clue game board.
    UIClueGame
    The main GUI class, handles the home screen and player setup.
